blind.description: A compact heap representing a coiled or jumbled pile of rusty chain links. Rather than distinct interlocking chain rings with open centers, the segments are heavily fused together into continuous, rounded tubular noodles or blobs with a mottled rust-brown metallic/dirt texture. It rests directly on the floor without an added base or plinth, sitting flat on its bottom with no floating parts or illumination.
blind.from_above: A roughly circular tangled knot of brownish tubular segments, resembling a coiled mass of rusty links, intestines, or a small mound of droppings, with one curved segment curling out at the upper right.
defects: Chain links are fused together into solid tubular masses rather than having open loops and distinct articulated links
Looks like tangled sausages or intestines due to melted/congealed link geometry
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 8 to 10 inches tall (about one-eighth the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1.2 to 1.5 feet in diameter.

notes: Chain links are fused into solid tubular segments rather than distinct interlocking rings with open centers
